sets (
            code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   -- z.B. sv9
            name TEXT,               -- z.B. Journey-Together
            short_code TEXT          -- z.B. JTG
        )

cards(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- z.B. sv9-1
    set_code TEXT,                -- z.B. sv9
    name TEXT,
    supertype TEXT,
    subtypes TEXT,
    number TEXT,
    rarity TEXT,
    image_small TEXT,
    image_large TEXT,
    cardmarket_url TEXT,
    cardmarket_product_id INTEGER
)

card_prices(
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    card_id TEXT,                 -- sv9-1
    cardmarket_product_id INTEGER,
    date TEXT,                    -- ISO Datum (aus API)
    price_en_nm_de REAL,          -- EN, NEAR_MINT, Seller Germany (current)
    avg7_normal REAL,             -- 7d average (EN, Germany, NEAR_MINT)
    avg30_normal REAL,            -- 30d average
    variant TEXT                  -- 'NORMAL' (für später, falls du Reverse ergänzen willst)
)
